user.title: MeteoSwiss Radar
user.description:
Adds the MeteoSwiss radar proxy and the `meteoswiss-radar-card` Lovelace card. Local rain-nowcast entities are optional and off by default — enable them under Configure after setup.

Afterwards, reload the browser tab (in the Companion app: reset the frontend cache) — otherwise dashboards report "Custom element doesn't exist: meteoswiss-radar-card".

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: MeteoSwiss Radar options
init.description: The radar card works without any of this. These settings add sensors that predict rain at your home, e.g. to retract an awning automatically.

data_description.nowcast_enabled: Reads the radar at the Home Assistant location every 5 min. "Next rain" looks up to 2 h ahead; the "Rain protection" switch for automations reacts to rain within 30 min.

rain_detection.name: Radar rain detection
rain_detection.description: Sets sensitivity for all radar-derived rain sensors. Hourly weather forecasts use their own thresholds.

data_description.rain_threshold_mm_h: Choose 1 mm/h to ignore the weakest radar band (standard), or 0 to include it for sensitive awnings. Including weak echoes may cause false alarms.

rain_protection.name: Rain protection: smooth out flapping
rain_protection.description: At the edge of a shower the radar can switch between rain and dry within minutes. This keeps "Rain protection" on for a minimum time, so the awning does not move in and out repeatedly.

data_description.protection_min_hold_minutes: Only affects the "Rain protection" switch, not the status sensor. 0 = off as soon as the radar is dry.

forecast.name: Next rain beyond 2 hours
forecast.description: The radar looks 2 hours ahead. After that, "Next rain" uses the hourly forecast of a weather entity (from 0.1 mm at 50 % probability).

data.weather_entity_id: Weather entity for the hourly forecast

data_description.weather_entity_id: The sensor shows which source answered: radar or forecast. Empty = radar only.

options.0: 0 mm/h — include the weakest radar band
